entries.finding: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 1.04188900271 d; Giacalone et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163...99G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GIACALONE_ET_AL__2022): a/R* derived from its semi-major axis 0.0171 au and stellar radius 0.6 solar radii; Giacalone et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163...99G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GIACALONE_ET_AL__2022): inclination derived from its impact parameter 0.31 with its a/R* 6.1284 (Winn 2010, eq. 7); No archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular; ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): transit mid-time 2458544.120496 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 19 min); Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north)..
